annotations.title: Check a page's SEO and AI search visibility

description: Checks one public web page the way search engines see it: HTTP status, robots.txt and meta robots rules for Googlebot, Bingbot and AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot), canonical, sitemap presence, title, meta description, headings and sharing tags. Use it when someone asks why a page isn't indexed, isn't found by ChatGPT or Perplexity, or wants an SEO check of a URL.
name: check_page_seo
title: Check a page's SEO and AI search visibility
